People who listen to podcasts are likely to engage with multiple media formats (audio and video).
Supporting nonprofit causes through donations aligns with listeners' moral values.
Nonprofit organizations should maintain neutrality on political issues to preserve public trust.
Online donation links are perceived as convenient and reliable.
Podcast audiences expect clear instructions on how to access content across platforms.
The phrase 'think local, think brasses' carries positive connotations related to community pride and engagement.
Sponsorship disclosure enhances the credibility of the podcast.
YouTube viewership complements audio podcast consumption without diminishing its value.
